subject: owl
name: 猫头鹰
label: 滑翔的猫头鹰
learning: 先观察主体各部分怎样连接，再挑几处有特点的细节。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. One barn owl gliding toward the viewer at a gentle angle, heart-shaped face, broad outstretched wings with a few large feather divisions and fanned tail.
STRICT RENDERING: Only clean pure black contour lines. All body interiors are completely blank white or transparent. Absolutely no shading, no gray tones, no washes, no feather marks or material texture. Put the complete artwork inside the center 65 percent of the canvas so every extremity has a generous blank margin. Both outstretched wing tips must be fully visible, far from edges. Only five broad feather lobes per wing, smoothly joined torso and head.
